steps.content:
15:15, May 30, N.F. 114
Intelligence Center, FAC HQ

steps.speaker: Comms
steps.content: Warning! Monitoring Station 1 of the Broken Frontline has been <color=#fb9259>attacked</color>! I repeat, Monitoring Station of the Broken Frontline has been attacked!

steps.speaker: Comms
steps.content: The nature of the attack is unclear, but all lighting equipment is failing. We can't see anything!

steps.speaker: Comms
steps.content: We're hearing noise... scary noise... Please send reinforcements!!
The radio interference is getting more piercing. The HQ's screen is showing what's happening on the frontline. As the FAC soldier said, it's pitch black.

steps.speaker: Comms
steps.content: <color=#fb9259>Darkness</color>... We can't find the way... Can't get out... Going to be trapped here forever...
A significant portion of the frontline personnel are giving incoherent responses, clearly showing signs of mental disorder.

steps.speaker: Comms
steps.content: My leg... my leg! It should have recovered... but how come I can't stand up anymore...

steps.speaker: Comms
steps.content: Why... in this place... But they already died when...

steps.speaker: Comms
steps.content: There are too many of them... We can't win... Go away, arghhhh!
A brief burst of gunfire is heard, but it's quickly drowned out by a chilling growl and the sound of viscous liquid dripping.
After that, everything goes silent. The calls are never answered again.
15:19, May 30, N.F. 114, four minutes after the arrival of a new DisSea tide, contact with DisSea Monitoring Station 1 is lost.

20:21, May 30, N.F. 114
MBCC Chief's Office
Schorl, the <color=#fb9259>support</color> given to you by Paradeisos during <color=#fb9259>desperate times</color>, is floating noiselessly before you.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: The <color=#fb9259>unknown contamination</color> leaking from BR-000 has now fully covered Monitoring Station 1 and is spreading to Monitoring Stations 2 and 3.

steps.speaker: Option
options: Should I head to the frontline?

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: We would advise against that.
The voice from the device is void of emotions.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: FAC HQ has already launched a rescue. Currently, six frontline combatants have been saved with no physical injuries, only varying degrees of mental distress.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: Two of them are still conscious and have reported about the situation inside the contamination. So far, the threat posed by this DisSea tide appears significantly lower than previous ones and remains manageable.
Seemingly observing your reaction, the mechanical voice pauses briefly before speaking again.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: We understand how you feel and recognize your need for certain information. We are equally eager for news about the expedition, however...

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: There's a very high chance that the DisSea tide is a trap designed for you. Your contact with the contamination might escalate the situation.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: Based on the current situation, we hope you can keep your distance from this DisSea tide and observe with patience.
The machine isn't lying. Your previous encounters in DisSea have already taught you painful lessons.
Dreya, Marguerite, and Vanilla all unknowingly became <color=#fb9259>bait</color> for the DisSea to capture you.
You can't make the same mistake again. Knowing full well they're gone, you shouldn't let the enemy tarnish their sacrifice.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I accept your advice and share your view. That said, I wish to keep up with the operation and be informed of all new developments. I want to reserve the right to participate in discussions on any emergencies.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Will Paradeisos... no, that man you represent, accept this proposal?
After a moment, Schorl gives its answer, coldly.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: Of course. He had expected this from you since the tide started to rise.

02:48, May 31, N.F. 114
MBCC Chief's Bedroom

You've been closely monitoring the frontline situation for over ten hours. Overall, things are looking optimistic. The contamination hasn't spiraled out of control, and more trapped individuals have escaped the mutated area.
But you can still feel the subtle connection between you and the DisSea. It's constantly influencing your mind, tempting you to venture into the contamination.
You set up several Hypercube shields in your bedroom.
Eleven hours have passed since the DisSea tide outbreak. You close your eyes.
The moment your consciousness returns, you feel enveloped by a heavy and viscous substance.
Sleep hasn't eased your fatigue. Instead, you find it hard to breathe.
Darkness.
It seems your retinas have completely lost their function. You see nothing but <color=#fb9259>endless darkness</color>.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Where am I?
You ask vigilantly out of instinct. But no response comes from the darkness.
You grope around in the dark for a long time, touching some familiar objects: a military Mania detector, Hypercube shields, and so on.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: No, that's not right.
You were just in your bedroom. You haven't gone to the DisSea or come into contact with the contamination.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: So, is this a dream? Has the Illusory Moon captured me again?
Enduring the unpleasant darkness, you stand up.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Looks like the only choice I've ever had is to face it.
As you reach this conclusion, the previously silent darkness begins to change.
Sounds reemerge in this space. A strange writhing noise in the darkness, the drip of liquid, and howls that seem to come from a wailing monster not far away.
Unperturbed by these oddities, you contemplate a crucial question instead.
As if hearing your question, several specks of <color=#fb9259>light</color> near you suddenly come into sight in the endless darkness.
Compared to the darkness itself, the light is so faint that it may well go out at any moment, yet it's so conspicuous against the pure darkness.
You have no other choice now. Going near a trap is better than going nowhere.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Stay cautious and be aware of the situation. I'm here to seek the truth, not to step into a trap.
Thinking this, you stride forward, wading through the darkness.
